notes: Hiphil's only slot (yiqtol 3ms) is attested twice, identically, in 2Sam.22.17 and its parallel Ps.18.17 -- 2Sam.22.17 kept as citation per the usual duplicate-slot tie-break.

Gloss collision: "draw out" is a very common clause, already shared by three existing roots -- דלה (H1802, "draw water; draw out"), רוק (H7324, "empty out; draw out"), and חשף (H2834, "lay bare; draw out") -- disambiguating search alias added.
